Frozen Cookies & Cream Protein Bars

Creamy Greek-yogurt protein bars with vanilla, crunchy Oreo pieces and a cool, cheesecake-like texture straight from the freezer.

Prep
10 min
Cook
Not listed
Total
Not listed
Difficulty
Not listed
Ingredients
7

Ingredients

  • 200 g plain Greek yogurt
  • 1 scoop cookies-and-cream protein powder
  • 10 g zero-calorie sweetener, or to taste
  • 8 g sugar-free vanilla pudding mix (about 1 serving)
  • 100 g fat-free milk
  • 1 tsp vanilla extract
  • 2 Oreo cookies, crushed

Amounts are scaled from 4 original servings. Season to taste.

Instructions

  1. In a bowl, whisk Greek yogurt, protein powder, sweetener, pudding mix, milk and vanilla until smooth.
  2. Crush the Oreos into small pieces and fold them through the mixture.
  3. Divide into four silicone bar molds or small freezer-safe molds. Tap gently to remove air pockets.
  4. Freeze for at least 4 hours, until firm. Let a bar sit at room temperature for 3–5 minutes before eating for a softer bite.

Cook times may vary when changing batch size.
